Proposal: one owned waiting bootstrap, durable exact process/assignment binding, parent-only release, and final current-generation validation under the permanent seat lock before same-PID exec. All handshake/completion waits and publication/Git/network work stay outside seat. Unknown identity/save/release failures cannot grant execution. Retry distinguishes never-released bootstrap cleanup from possibly executed work. Durability requires fsync, not only the existing atomic rename.

Binding prerequisite: BUG-1808 owns the shared launcher/assignment/receipt substrate first, per independent comment `01a11983-323f-7a13-85b7-87635929a4e2`. Its pending v3/v4 proposals are not adopted as signed policy. Request independent approval of a bounded shared-local-launch slice; TASK-1607 consumes it and adds occupancy validation, BUG-1802 consumes later. If exact assignment publication requires BUG-1808's pending Git/callback integration, affected production pickup remains disabled until that precise prerequisite lands. No competing schema or circular dependency.

Review must decide the prerequisite slice, local record/release/final-exec C8 clarification, and explicit pane/daemon/containment adapter support. Source anchors, parent-death/FD/channel behavior, bounded cleanup/retry rules and actual-entrypoint first-action-sentinel test matrix are in the full sketch. All tests are PROPOSED; none run here.

- PRODUCTION_GATEWAYS_READY.md still says NOT READY. Full gateway audit/history/full acceptance remain outstanding; disabled kill, C7 F1/F2/F3 and TASK-1337/1603 ordering remain required.
